{{Quote|It was ''I'' who allowed the alliance to know the location of the shield generator. It is quite safe from your ''pitiful'' little band. An entire ''legion'' of my best troops await them. Oh...I'm afraid the deflector shield will be quite operational when your friends arrive.|Palpatine to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], regarding the vulnerability of the Endor shield generator.|<ref name="Episode VI" />}}
'''Tempest Force''' was an [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]], [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]] and [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Navy]] joint-task unit stationed on [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor's]] [[Endor/Legends|forest moon]] during [[3 ABY/Legends|3]]&ndash;[[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. The unit comprised some of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military's]] best troops, with the total force strength being comparable to a [[Legion/Legends|legion]]. It was tasked with guarding the [[Endor shield generator bunker|shield generator bunker]] on the Forest Moon from the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] as part of a trap set by the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]].<ref name="Episode VI" />

==Description==
Tempest Force was led by [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Dyer/Legends|Dyer]], [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Igar/Legends|Igar]], and [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Hewex]]. Other notable [[Imperial officer/Legends|officers]] included Major [[Marquand/Legends|Marquand]], [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Watts]], Lieutenant [[Grond (Imperial)|Grond]] and Lieutenant [[Renz/Legends|Renz]]. The unit consisted of members from the Imperial Army, Imperial Navy, and Stormtrooper Corps. The troops were made up of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], [[Scout trooper/Legends|scout troopers]], and [[Death Star Trooper/Legends|Death Star troopers]],<ref name="Episode VI" /> handpicked by Igar.<ref name="EliteSquadronStormtrooper">{{CCG|set=Endor Limited|cardname=Elite Squadron Stormtrooper}}</ref> They were also assisted by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Sarkli]] and his [[Storm commando/Legends|Storm commandos]].<ref name="Rebel Strike" /> Tempest Force had at least one [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-AT]], ''[[Tempest 1]]'', at least 39 [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-STs]], and many [[74-Z speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]]. Overall, Tempest Force was comparable to a [[Legion/Legends|legion]].<ref name="Episode VI" />

==History==
===Beginnings===
{{Quote|I served six years in Tempest Force, rising to sergeant. We were one of the finest legions in the New Order.|Hume Tarl|<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare" />}}
[[File:Tempestforce2.jpg|thumb|left|230px|Tempest Force in action on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]]]
Tempest Force was created in or before [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]]. Stormtrooper [[Hume Tarl/Legends|Hume Tarl]] joined that year and rose to the rank of [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] by [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare" />

When the Forest Moon of Endor was chosen as the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II's]] construction site, [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] assigned Tempest Force to defend the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star's]] [[Endor shield generator bunker|shield generator bunker]].<ref name="Episode VI" /> [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Tiaan Jerjerrod/Legends|Tiaan Jerjerrod]], Colonel Dyer, and Commander Igar helped coordinate Tempest Force's troops and where they were to be positioned.<ref name="FF" /><ref name="Igar" />

In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Palpatine planned to lure the Rebels into a trap to destroy them. He secretly let them obtain information about where the Death Star II was being constructed, so the Rebels would arrive to destroy it. Palpatine planned for any Rebel ground troops sent to deactivate the shield to be captured by Tempest Force, while the arriving Rebel fleet would be trapped and destroyed between the Death Star's shield and emerging [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]].<ref name="Episode VI" />

===Battle of Endor===
When the Rebel [[Endor strike team/Legends|strike team]] landed, they were spotted by scout trooper [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] [[Avarik]] and Sergeant [[Elsek]]. Avarik signaled for Elsek to get reinforcements, while he fought Rebel [[General/Legends|General]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], but another Rebel, [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], managed to shoot down Elsek. The confrontation was witnessed by Sergeant [[Barich]] and another scout trooper, who quickly fled on their speeder bikes. Rebels [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] took Avarik's speeder bike and pursued them. When they caught up with Barich's partner, Skywalker jumped over to his bike and knocked the scout trooper off, taking the vehicle for himself. Two more scout troopers, Corporals [[Drelosyn]] and [[Misik]], began following the Rebels and shooting at them, so Skywalker broke off to take care of the two while Organa continued following Barich. Using his speeder, Skywalker shot Drelosyn, causing him to crash into a tree, but was forced to jump off when his speeder became stuck on Misik's. With his lightsaber, Skywalker damaged Misik's speeder as he flew by again, making him crash into a tree, as well. Meanwhile, Leia kept up with Barich until he began shooting his blaster at her, causing her to fall off. Barich looked back to see her fall, but didn't realize that he was on a collision course for a fallen log, in which he and his bike exploded as he hit it.<ref name="Episode VI" />

Later, the strike team was nearly captured again, this time by an approaching AT-ST. However, the Rebels captured the pilots and forced them to make check-in calls with their superiors to explain their absence.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi">''[[Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi]]''</ref> Meanwhile, other members of the strike team met with the local [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|tribe]], who agreed to help them fight against the Empire. Skywalker separated from the group in order to confront his father, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], and turn him back to the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]]. He allowed himself to captured by Commander Igar, who brought him to the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]]. Though Skywalker said he was alone, Igar still conducted a search of the area for any other Rebels, though he ultimately found none.<ref name="Episode VI" />

The next day, the Rebels regrouped and were showed the bunker's back entrance by some Ewoks, which was guarded by only four scout troopers. One of the Ewoks, [[Paploo/Legends|Paploo]], stole a speeder bike, resulting in three of the four scout troopers giving chase. The Rebels captured the remaining trooper and entered the bunker, with the exception of [[Nik Sant/Legends|Nik Sant]], who donned the trooper's armor and stood guard outside the bunker, taking up the trooper's position. The rebels ran into some stormtroopers in the bunker's hallways, but quickly defeated them and continued to the control room, where they forced the Imperials, including Major Hewex, against the wall and began planting charges.<ref name="Episode VI" />

[[File:EndorStrikeTeamCapture.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Tempest Force captures the Rebels.]]
As part of the Emperor's plan, Commander Igar and Colonel Dyer were expecting them and sent in troops to capture the Rebels. Dyer accompanied the troops and was the first to enter the control room. He stuck his gun at General Solo and ordered him to freeze, but was killed when Solo threw a charge at him, knocking him off of a railing and into the generator room, below. Lieutenant Renz, along with the rest of the troops, arrived after and captured the Rebels. As they were led outside, Ewoks attacked the Imperials, [[Battle of Endor/Legends|leading to chaos]].<ref name="Episode VI" />

The Rebels took advantage of the situation and freed themselves, while some of the Imperials, including Hewex, sealed themselves back in the bunker. As the battle raged on, the Ewoks incapacitated many Imperial troops with rocks and destroyed several AT-STs with logs. The tide of the battle turned when one of the AT-STs, [[Tempest Scout 2/Legends|Tempest Scout 2]], piloted by Major Marquand and Lieutenant Watts, was captured by Chewbacca and several Ewoks, who used the walker to destroy other AT-STs. Several Imperials believed that Marquand and Watts had turned against them and ordered the walker to stand down, not realizing that it had been captured by the Rebels.<ref name="Rebel Strike" />

Outside the bunker's back entrance, Solo, Organa, and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] tried to open the door, but their efforts were unsuccessful, as both Organa and R2-D2 were non-fatally shot, and Solo's attempts to hot-wire the door accidentally shut the blast doors, further locking them out. Chewbacca, piloting the stolen AT-ST, arrived, however, and Solo had a new plan. He put on Marquand's uniform and used the walker to contact the bunker's control room, telling Hewex that the Rebels were on the run and they needed reinforcements to pursue them. Hewex fell for the trick and ordered the back door to be opened to allow three extra squads to help. When the doors opened and the Imperials ran out, they were quickly surrounded by Rebels and surrendered.<ref name="Episode VI" />

Solo and the Rebels entered the bunker and once again began setting charges. When the charges were primed to explode and the Rebels ran out of the bunker,<ref name="Episode VI" /> Captain Sarkli confronted Solo near the entrance but was shot and killed.<ref name="Rebel Strike" /> The bunker exploded and the shield generator was deactivated, allowing the Rebel fleet above to begin attacking the Death Star, which they managed to destroy.<ref name="Episode VI" />

===Post-battle===
With the Death Star gone and many Imperial higher-ups killed, the remaining Imperials of Tempest Force either were captured, formed holdouts, or evacuated. The rebels began landing more troops and taking them out. Some of the Imperial troops that were taken prisoner were almost happy to be captured, as it meant getting away from the Ewoks that had terrorized them.<ref name="AE" />

One [[Unidentified scout trooper (Endor)|scout trooper]] was part of a squad that, prior to the battle, had been sent to the far side of the moon. After the battle, they received no further orders and were unaware of the Rebels's victory. For over a year, the squad stayed put and slowly died, one by one, until the scout trooper had enough and deserted his post. A month after leaving, the trooper ran into a [[Unidentified Rebel trooper (Endor)|rebel trooper]] who had also been left behind. The two formed a truce and made their way to the bunker, where they found it destroyed. Using an abandoned AT-ST, the pair made their way to a Star Destroyer that had crashed during the battle and contacted a nearby freighter for help. The rebel left on the freighter but the scout trooper stayed behind, choosing to remain on Endor.<ref name="Marooned">{{Tales|22|Marooned}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Although not named in [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Return of the Jedi'']], the Endor expansion of the CCG goes into detail regarding Tempest Force. Many of the cards also reference to the [[Battle of Kashyyyk (19 BBY)|subjugation of Kashyyyk]]. It is possible that an earlier version of Tempest Force was present there.

In one of the deleted scenes for ''Return of the Jedi'', Moff Jerjerrod's dialogue referred to the unit as being composed of "several battalions," even though Palpatine in the movie itself implies that its size was comparable to a legion.
